mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle contraction in industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output declines signal reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is in a late-cycle contraction, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market slack reduces wage pressures and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates potential monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy that is causing labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recession risks.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units in a month, it indicates a sharp slowdown in the housing sector that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
